blocks.text: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Sunday dismissed as “fake news” Vice President Sara Duterte’s allegation that his administration was behind efforts to discredit her, challenging her to present evidence to support her accusations. “Well, it is fake news! … Prove it! Based on what?” Marcos said during a Kapihan interview in Singapore on the final day of his five-day working visit. The president was responding to questions about Duterte’s accusation that his administration was behind allegations raised by dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., who claimed to have delivered large sums of cash to the Vice President and members […]...
